subject: Proposal: compress two demo blocks into a single training workshop
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@clearbridge.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Park <tom.park@clearbridge.io>
Date: 2026-10-17T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Two adjacent enablement blocks — would you consider combining?

Hi Jonas / Camila,

Hope you're both well. We have two back-to-back half-day enablement bookings next week (API enablement AM, Console walkthrough PM) but several of our engineers have asked if we can compress those into a single full-day workshop instead to reduce context switching and travel overhead.

Current plan:
- Oct 22: API enablement 9:00–12:00 PT
- Oct 22: Console walkthrough 13:00–16:00 PT

Would Redwood be able to run a contiguous 9:30–16:30 PT session (with a longer lunch) that preserves the hands-on lab time? If so we can consolidate attendee invites.

Attendees: Alyssa (ops), Tom (platform), 6 engineers (TBD). We will need dedicated lab seats and temporary API keys.

Thanks,
Alyssa

--
Alyssa Chen
IT Program Manager | ClearBridge Health
alyssa.chen@clearbridge.io
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@clearbridge.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-17T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Two adjacent enablement blocks — would you consider combining?

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the note. We can absolutely do a single full-day workshop; happy to stitch the two blocks together. A few quick questions so we scope the lab time correctly: 

1) Headcount: please confirm final attendee list and roles (dev/ops/product).
2) Sequence preference: do you want API hands-on first then Console, or Console intro then API lab?
3) Lab environment: do you want sandbox-only or access to a demo project with sample data?

Attached is a draft agenda that shows how we compress content while keeping 2x 45-minute hands-on slots. I’m proposing 9:30 start to allow east coast folks to join at 12:30 ET. If that works, we’ll send merged calendar invites and provision temporary API keys the morning of.

Proposed merged window: 2026-10-22 09:30–16:30 PT (includes 60m lunch).

Attachments: [Attachment: session_agenda-draft.pdf (PDF)]

Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@clearbridge.io>
Date: 2026-10-17T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Two adjacent enablement blocks — would you consider combining?

Jonas / Camila — quick heads-up from infra: merging is fine but we have two constraints to flag so the session doesn't get blocked mid-demo:

- Lab VM quota: ClearBridge currently has 8 sandbox seats; if you confirm 6 engineers that’s okay, but any more and we need to pre-provision a second pool (takes ~4 hours).
- Persistent KV caching test: if we run longer end-to-end demos with larger context windows, memory pressure could increase latency for the later slots; recommend we limit any single hands-on exercise to ~1k token windows or schedule a brief restart during lunch.

If Alyssa confirms final headcount by EOD today we’ll push the extra nodes and publish an access checklist.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Solutions Ops | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: lab-access-checklist.xlsx (Excel)]

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@clearbridge.io>

Subject: Re: Two adjacent enablement blocks — would you consider combining?

Thanks Jonas — that looks good. Couple of confirmations:

- Headcount: Confirmed 7 total (Tom + 5 eng + Alyssa).
- Sequence: API enablement in the morning (hands-on + temporary keys), then Console walkthrough + Q&A in the afternoon.
- Lab preference: sandbox with a seeded demo project (preferred).

We’re fine with the suggested 09:30–16:30 PT window. Please go ahead and provision the extra VM pool Ben mentioned. Also can you add a short 15-minute intro at the top for our security lead to state policy constraints?

If you can send updated merged invites and the final agenda, I’ll update our internal calendar and confirm attendee names.

Cheers,
Alyssa

Perfect — thanks for the quick confirmation, Alyssa. I’ve:
